exposure.title: Direct + fund exposure
exposure.description: See direct investments and estimated exposure through mutual funds and ETFs. Expand a security to see each source. This view does not add underlying holdings to your portfolio value.
exposure.coverage_note: Fund disclosures may be partial or dated. Unexpanded value includes undisclosed holdings, cash and other assets. Securities without a composition remain direct, unexpanded positions; identify your funds using Manage fund data. Exposure is one level deep, not a recursive fund-of-funds calculation.
exposure.import_help: Import an issuer CSV with identifier (ISIN or MARKET:TICKER, e.g. NSE:RELIANCE or US:AAPL), name, and weightPercent columns. Weights are percentages, e.g. 8.5. Import equity constituents only; cash, bonds and undisclosed holdings remain unexpanded. Review the rows before saving.
